WITH DISTINCT p
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0 OR CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) < 1984 OR (CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1984 AND (CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10 OR (CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) <= 14))))

WITH DISTINCT p, t
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'january') THEN 1
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'february') THEN 2
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'march') THEN 3
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'april') THEN 4
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'may') THEN 5
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'june') THEN 6
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'july') THEN 7
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'august') THEN 8
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'september') THEN 9
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'october') THEN 10
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'november') THEN 11
    WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'december') THEN 12
  END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) END AS birth_day
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0 OR birth_year < 1984 OR (birth_year = 1984 AND (birth_month < 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day <= 14))))
MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, t
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+, [0-9]{4}$') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'january') THEN 1
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'february') THEN 2
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'march') THEN 3
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'april') THEN 4
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'may') THEN 5
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'june') THEN 6
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'july') THEN 7
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'august') THEN 8
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'september') THEN 9
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'october') THEN 10
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'november') THEN 11
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') AND CONTAINS(LOWER(p.birth_date), 'december') THEN 12
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]{4}$') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 1), ' ', 2) AS INT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_day
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0 OR birth_year < 1984 OR (birth_year = 1984 AND (birth_month < 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day <= 14))))
WITH DISTINCT p, t
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
